proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + magic_item family
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord = SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord. No MagicItemRecord exists. The tracer exhaustive switch covers only 'spell', 'class_feature', 'mastery' — kind: 'magic_item' throws unhandled.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_ability_score
proposed_widenings.justification: Agility, Fortitude, Insight, Intellect, Leadership, Strength variants grant +2 to an ability score capped at 20. Taxonomy v4 explicitly lists modify_ability_score as out-of-scope residue. First concrete pressure from magic item validation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Your Dexterity increases by 2, to a maximum of 20, while this deep-red sphere orbits your head.

proposed_widenings.name: negate_spell_by_level (ReactionEffect variant)
proposed_widenings.justification: Absorption cancels any spell of level 4 or lower; Greater Absorption level 8 or lower. Existing negate_named_effect requires a specific spellId. A level-ceiling negate needs a new variant shape.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Reaction to cancel a spell of level 4 or lower cast by a creature you can see

proposed_widenings.name: level-sum charge counter
proposed_widenings.justification: Absorption burns out after absorbing 20 cumulative spell levels, not 20 uses. Existing charge atom tracks discrete use counts. A running level-sum counter with a maximum cap is a structurally distinct shape.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Once the stone has canceled 20 levels of spells, it burns out, turns dull gray, and loses its magic.

proposed_widenings.name: periodic_heal (hourly cadence)
proposed_widenings.justification: Regeneration grants 15 HP at end of each hour. No existing window atom covers an hourly real-time cadence — rest_window covers short/long rests, turn_end_window covers combat turns. An hour-cadence window is a new shape.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You regain 15 Hit Points at the end of each hour if you have at least 1 Hit Point

proposed_widenings.name: modify_proficiency_bonus
proposed_widenings.justification: Mastery variant increases PB by 1. No v4 effect atom covers direct PB modification as a worn-item passive. scale_numeric_bonus modifies existing numeric values inside a feature; this is a persistent bonus to the PB stat itself.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Your Proficiency Bonus increases by 1 while this pale green prism orbits your head.

proposed_widenings.name: RollKind: 'ability_check' / 'initiative'
proposed_widenings.justification: Awareness grants Advantage on Initiative rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks. RollKind = 'attack_roll' | 'saving_throw' only — no ability_check or initiative variant exists.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you have Advantage on Initiative rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks

proposed_widenings.name: stored_spell payload family (Reserve variant)
proposed_widenings.justification: Reserve stores up to 4 spell levels; any creature can cast spells into it; owner casts stored spells using original caster's DC/attack bonus. This is a multi-party spell-storage/relay flow with no existing family analog.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This vibrant purple prism stores spells cast into it, holding them until you use them.

notes: Primary blocker is structural: UnitRecord has no magic_item kind and the tracer exhaustive switch throws on it. No .dhall or .json content produced. Secondary blockers are deep: modify_ability_score (taxonomy residue, out-of-scope), level-sum charge counter for Absorption, hourly heal cadence for Regeneration, PB modification for Mastery, RollKind widening for Awareness, and a stored_spell multi-party relay for Reserve. Sustenance (biological need suppression) is dm_agenda-adjacent and has no deterministic mechanical resolution in core. The item is a compound unit covering 11 distinct stone types — even after structural widening, individual variants would require separate encoding passes.
